primary_meaning: A new spiritual identity or transformed character bestowed by God on the faithful/overcomer, signifying redemption, intimate belonging, and eternal status before Him

alternatives.meaning: A unique secret personal name known only to the recipient and God, denoting private intimacy and recognition
Inscription of God's own name (or Christ's new name) and the New Jerusalem upon the believer, marking ownership and heavenly citizenship
Literal new personal name assigned in the afterlife or heavenly realm
Symbol of conversion, baptism, or Christian renaming practices reflecting a changed life
basis: traditional Christian practice linking biblical renamings (e.g., Abram/Abraham, Jacob/Israel, Saul/Paul)

notes: Christian interpretation consistently treats 'new name' as divine bestowal of renewed identity or status drawn from OT prophetic renaming and NT apocalyptic promises; secondary details (secret personal name versus divine name written on the person) differ among commentators but do not overturn the core consensus.
